question: In an epidemiological cohort study, what do we mean by exposed patients?

options.opa: Patients who have the risk factor of the disease or health problem we want to study.
options.opb: Patients who agree to participate in the study after giving their informed consent.
options.opc: Subjects who do not develop the disease or health problem under study during follow-up.
options.opd: Patients who have the disease or health problem we want to study.

analysis: In an epidemiological cohort study, exposed patients refer to individuals who have the risk factor of the disease or health problem being studied. These individuals are compared to unexposed individuals to assess the relationship between the exposure and the outcome.
